name: Vandevert Ranch
label: Vandevert Ranch
about_prose: Vandevert Ranch sits on 400 acres along both banks of the Little Deschutes River, about 16 miles south of Bend and just south of Sunriver. The land was homesteaded in 1892 by William Plutarch Vandevert, predating the city of Bend and Deschutes County, and operated as a working cattle ranch for nearly a century. The original log homestead and one-room schoolhouse survive on the property and are listed among Deschutes County's Historic Resources.

In 1988, Jim and Carol Gardner purchased and restored the homestead, converting the ranch into a gated residential community of roughly 22 custom homesites. Design guidelines require log, timber, and stone construction. The homeowners association holds about 350 acres of common land, including meadows, river frontage, a private fishing pond, and equestrian facilities.

amenities.name: Little Deschutes River Access
amenities.description: Private put-in and take-out points run along both banks of the river through the property.

amenities.name: Private Fishing Pond
amenities.description: A 3.2-acre pond with 1,000 feet of shoreline, stocked with rainbow trout.

amenities.name: Equestrian Facilities
amenities.description: Horse boarding with stables, a riding arena, paddocks, pasture, and 8 miles of riding trails, with a full-time animal caretaker.

amenities.name: Tennis and Pickleball Courts
amenities.description: On-site courts for community residents, alongside walking and biking trails through the common land.

amenities.name: Historic Homestead and Schoolhouse
amenities.description: The 1892 log homestead and one-room schoolhouse are preserved on the property and listed among the county's Historic Resources.

drive_times.note: Vandevert Road is about 3 miles south of the Sunriver exit on US-97
